name: Eclipse Cathedral Wyrm
prompt: Create a mechanical cathedral dragon with enormous stained-glass wings, an articulated reliquary body, a living eclipse core, and a cinematic wing-opening awakening.
description: A full boss-scale dragon built as a moving reliquary, with more than 200 optimized cubes, stained-glass tracery, articulated neck, jaw, legs and tail, and an eclipse-corona awakening.
